summary:
html-portfolio @ origin/main (tip 3a92179, 2026-08-25) is Meera/Maya, a Hinglish AI companion. This segment covers the call, voice, vision, Android, surfaces, games, telemetry and gates stack.
Realtime voice is shipped and measured. Gemini Live (3.1-flash-live) speech-to-speech runs over a browser WebSocket with single-use ephemeral tokens (api/live-token.js).
src/voice/liveCall.ts (3,408 lines) makes the client the floor authority: a mic hold ring, LISTEN/BARGE/SOFT bars, onset confirmation, a backchannel filter, an echo model with an r2-gated slope estimator, a phrase-boundary yield fade, a release watchdog, a stuck-turn watchdog, and a speech-never-dropped uplink policy.
The evals/echosim harness transpiles the real liveCall.ts into a virtual-clock browser with room acoustics and gates changes on an 80-call floor table plus stucksim and rotatesim.
The cascade fallback (STT -> LLM -> TTS) uses api/speech.js: a free streaming Gemini TTS lane plus a paid arm at 1.5 s, a 1000-byte anti-splice gate, a two-phase fuse, and a server-side text-to-speech sanitiser mirrored char-for-char from src/voice/spokenText.ts.
Voice identity is one name (Despina) across six lanes in four languages, with one writer (verify-voice.mjs --set), identity in every cache key, and a blind ear-test deck. goAway is answered by rotation in both the TS and Java twins, with the model pinned for the call.
Screen share during a call is shipped and measured. A pure-geometry scene detector (scene.ts, with a Java twin) wakes on the arrest of movement; frames are 600 ms / 768 px / q0.68 into the live socket, behind strict grounding gates.
The Android Capacitor app has a custom OTA updater with a rollback chain, a mic fast path, beep-free on-device STT, a mediaProjection service, and playback capture with a saturating mixer.
Surfaces have a four-function adapter contract with a single fail-closed gatedReply choke point. Telegram, Discord and WhatsApp are code-complete, but send() has never been called.
Games (chess, ttt, wyr) run as a generic ActivityState seam: move is code, talk is model; think-time is a table; notes go through a stale/hold/send seam; there is a lifecycle matrix.
Observability: telemetry contract, a 7-leg turn trace (references only, retention at write), and a content-free diag sink. Gates: verify-release (13), prompt budget with a pinned worst date, motion/contrast/copy/workflow lints, and verify-deploy.
For Taxila (Azure gpt-realtime-2.1): the arbiter, echo, uplink, watchdog, yield, rotation, echosim harness, scene detector, OTA, trace and gates are portable. The socket protocol, the barge signal (speech_started), the 24 kHz input, the frame transport (no continuous channel; conversation.item.create input_image) and the voice roster must be rebuilt.
This repo already measured Azure realtime-mini failing on verbosity (41-53 words/turn), voice plausibility (137-192 Hz) and frames. Constants were tuned on adult signals and need a child-voice re-sweep.

assets.title: Client floor arbiter (hold ring + LISTEN/BARGE/SOFT bars + onset confirm + backchannel retire)
assets.what: While she is audible the mic is held in a 26-tick ring; a sound must clear duration and energy bars over a rolling 10th-percentile floor, onset duty 0.6 over 250 ms, and the backchannel and steadiness vetoes, and must not be her echo. Once it does, the whole ring is burst-released so no words are lost.
assets.evidence: echosim exp1/exp-barge tables; production 3/3 duck +171 ms, release +598 ms, stop +672 ms
assets.notes: Protocol-independent logic. Re-sweep for child voices (higher f0, quieter); ONSET_DUTY is one step from a cliff.

assets.title: Echo coupling model kappa with r2-gated affine fit
assets.what: kappa is seeded at 0.30, decays to the p90 of the measured ratio, and rises only on a locked best-lag fit (r2 >= 0.7, lags 0-260 ms). Her level is the peak 20 ms RMS at the playhead, with a 200 ms / -20 dB tail model and ECHO_MARGIN 1.3.
assets.evidence: self-interrupt 6/6 -> 0/6 at -12 dB ERL; -6 dB self-duck 91% -> 14%
assets.notes: Most valuable for phone speakerphone use by kids.

assets.title: Uplink policy: words never dropped, silence heartbeat, video yields to audio
assets.what: STALL_CEILING 400000, VIDEO_GATE 48000, SILENCE_CAP 8000, SILENCE_ENDPOINT_MS 700, SILENCE_KEEP 3, FRAME_MAX_B64 120000. Congestion is read from bufferedAmount troughs and is advisory.
assets.notes: Rescale byte thresholds by 1.5 for Azure's 24 kHz input.

assets.title: Stuck-turn watchdog (STUCK_OPEN_MS 20 s, FORCE_SILENCE_MS 700)
assets.what: If the gate stays open for 20 s with no generation, it forces real silence so the server endpoints the turn. Without it, a noisy room stops her answering forever.
assets.evidence: 0 ms of silence in 32 s without it vs ~700 ms with it; gated in verify-release
assets.notes: Indian homes and classrooms are noisy; must-have.

assets.title: Human yield (phrase-boundary fade) + release watchdog + straggler discard
assets.what: On interrupt she fades to the next word gap within 450 ms (130 ms if the overlap is over 700 ms). The client acts on its own decision after 600 ms if the server's interrupted never arrives. discardTurn blocks stray chunks for up to 2 s.
assets.evidence: median 5.05 s of unplayed lead at interrupt (n=4)
assets.notes: Re-derive the watchdog against Azure speech_started.

assets.title: Ephemeral single-use token mint, prewarm and staggered double attempt
assets.what: Server mints a single-use token (30 min expiry, 9 min start window). The client premints while the user is in chat (7 min cache), runs two staggered attempts and aborts the loser, and rate-limits to 12/min per IP.
assets.notes: Map to Azure realtime ephemeral session keys.

assets.title: Parallel mic + socket connect with timing breakdown
assets.what: getUserMedia and WebSocket+setup run concurrently, and the AudioContext is built during TLS. Reports mintMs/micMs/wsOpenMs/setupMs/uplinkMs/setupBytes/overlapMs.
assets.evidence: motivated by readyMs 7618 on a real device

assets.title: Session rotation on goAway (generation guards, model pinned, wait for quiet)
assets.what: Fresh socket, same model and voice; wsGen and sockReady guards; waits for speakingUntil (cap 4 s, kept 1.2 s inside the deadline); MAX_ROTATES 6; timeLeft parsed as seconds.
assets.notes: 30-60 min lessons will hit session limits; add a silent running-note recap (Meera declined recap).

assets.title: direct() out-of-band note channel (silent vs cue)
assets.what: A clientContent user turn: turnComplete true asks her to answer, false adds context only. Waits up to 1.2 s for her to finish speaking. Notes use angle brackets, never square.
assets.notes: Azure equivalent: conversation.item.create (+ response.create for a cue).

assets.title: level.ts asymmetric RMS presence envelope
assets.what: AnalyserNode RMS with attack 0.35 and release 0.08, so it looks like breathing rather than a VU meter.
assets.notes: Drives the avatar mouth/glow until a video avatar exists.

assets.title: Ring and pickup race (live vs cascade, late adoption at turn boundary)
assets.what: Contextual ring of 1.1-2.4 s. The live lane gets ring + 3.5 s, otherwise the cascade takes the call. adoptLiveLate waits for a turn boundary. The pickup directive carries the scene.

assets.title: Live setup-block learnings (thinking off, hi-IN, VAD end-high, 300 ms silence)
assets.what: thinkingBudget 0, languageCode hi-IN, END_SENSITIVITY_HIGH, silenceDurationMs 300, prefixPaddingMs 60; start sensitivity and NO_INTERRUPTION deliberately unset; sliding-window compression.
assets.notes: Gemini-specific; map to Azure server_vad/semantic_vad and re-measure.

assets.title: liveLookup: react first, look up beside the turn
assets.what: Narrow factual trigger (domain noun + question shape + no relational language). /api/search runs beside the turn and facts arrive through direct() about 1 s later.
assets.notes: The teacher looks up facts without dead air.

assets.title: farewell.ts closed-vocabulary goodbye detector
assets.what: Every token must be a farewell or a filler; requires the call to be >= 20 s old and her own goodbye; hangs up 1.4 s after it.
assets.notes: Kids' 'bye' vocabulary differs; extend the corpus.

assets.title: Call-lane context blocks with budgets (running note, shared history, just-happened, memory note)
assets.what: Head-anchored verbatim running note (8 rows, 900 B, salience not summarisation), shared history 700 B, just-happened 45 min / 300 B, memory note 500 B, activity ledger 300 B.
assets.evidence: callmem 341 assertions; running note carries minute 3 and 12 to minute 40
assets.notes: Use for long lessons and rotations.

assets.title: api/speech.js two-lane TTS proxy (stream, anti-splice gate, two-phase fuse, hedge, attribution headers)
assets.what: Free Gemini SSE streaming plus a paid arm at 1500 ms. FLUSH_MIN 1000 B is both the commit gate and the dead-key test. Fuse 1.4 s then one 15 s attempt. Paid hedge. X-Meera-Lane/Pool/Model/Voice/Rules headers. 422 when nothing is speakable.
assets.evidence: two-phase fuse saved the 2026-08-24 outage night
assets.notes: Port to Azure TTS for the fallback lane.

assets.title: spokenText sanitiser (text->speech seam), mirrored server-side
assets.what: Rule classes A-L: dashes become pauses, hyphens inside words are kept, markdown markers are removed but words kept, URL schemes removed but addresses kept, emoji dropped, ellipsis kept, empty string returned when nothing is speakable.
assets.notes: Must add a math/science notation class; rule B deletes <...>, which would delete '3 < 5 > 2'.

assets.title: shapeAck clip shaper (trim, restore edges, curved fades, level match)
assets.what: Core at -30 dB, edges restored to -55 dB, fades in 25 ms (u^1.6) and out 90 ms (u^3), peak20 RMS 0.0676, scale down and never clip; null when out of the 150-900 ms band.

assets.title: Post-turn listening sound (real voice clips, 420 ms after stop)
assets.what: Non-lexical clips Hmm/Mmhm/Mmm prefetched during the ring and cached under a voice-keyed IndexedDB key. Plays after >= 2.5 s of user talk, at most once per 15 s, never moves the playhead, and holds the mic across the tail.
assets.notes: ACK_ENABLED=false pending an ear verdict.

assets.title: verify-voice.mjs one-voice gate and --set single writer
assets.what: Checks name, model registry, sanitiser mirror, live-lane import law, cascade watch engine, TS/Java parity, identity in cache keys, door census. --set moves all six lanes.

assets.title: Blind voice-sample deck and ear protocol
assets.what: Shuffled A-F/H labels, the same lines and direction; listening order: real person, Hinglish, same person across lines, would you want them.
assets.notes: Run with parents and children for the teacher voice.

assets.title: prosody-baseline f0 and duration drift alarm
assets.what: f0 by autocorrelation, duration and words/s on a fixed deck; alarms on f0 +/-8%, duration +/-20%, or a model-string change.
assets.notes: Detects silent vendor voice changes.

assets.title: Cascade speech engine (stream speaker, engine latch per utterance, device fallback, fillers, ack)
assets.what: createStreamSpeaker, pickEngine once per utterance, VOICE_IDENTITY_WINS, playThinkingFiller, playAck always, ringback/room tone, duckSpeech.

assets.title: Voice-cloning posture and STT inventory (SPEECH-STACK)
assets.what: India voice personality rights; recommends a hired voice actor with explicit cloning terms; IndexTTS2 for timbre/emotion; 10-15 s instant / 20-30 min professional; the reference set must contain the register. STT is three en-IN lanes, unmeasured.
assets.notes: Teacher voice cloning for minors: get consent and contracts first.

assets.title: scene.ts SceneReader pure-geometry wake detector
assets.what: 32x32 luma grid every 120 ms. Wakes on the hold after movement relative to the user's rhythm. Scroll detected as translation, overlay bands ignored, pointer detected, FLAG_SECURE reads blank, pre-roll still frame. Show vs ambient classes.
assets.notes: Detects a child pausing on a worksheet or holding up a notebook.

assets.title: Web screen-share pipeline with grounding gates
assets.what: Detect at 12 fps; send 600 ms / 768 px / q0.68 at one quality; idle beat 2500 ms; flush on voice onset; wake gates (her voice, quiet, stale/still frame, show floor, ceiling 12 with ambient 5); every refusal is logged.
assets.notes: Azure has no frame channel: send sparse, wake-gated conversation items.

assets.title: WATCH_MODE_NOTE / WATCH_COMMENT_DIRECTIVE prompt shape
assets.what: Never name what is not on screen; first-time seeing; privacy tact (OTP by kind once); honest answer about what is seen and stored.
assets.notes: Rewrite for teacher plus minor privacy.

assets.title: Android native watch stack (capture FGS, Java twin, pure pacer, bubble)
assets.what: mediaProjection foreground service; frames sent only when delivered; cascade engine when live is unavailable; floating bubble.
assets.notes: Screen share is lower priority for kids; camera matters more.

assets.title: Playback capture plus saturating mixer
assets.what: AudioPlaybackCapture scoped to the projection; media at a fixed -6 dB under the mic; saturating sums; her own track ALLOW_CAPTURE_BY_NONE.

assets.title: Twin parity test (run Java vs TS, diff tick for tick)
assets.what: Compiles and runs the real Java twin against the bundled TS on identical frames and asserts they agree; fails, rather than skipping, without a JDK.

assets.title: Android OTA web-bundle updater with rollback chain
assets.what: trial->current->previous->assets; two silent boots roll back; sha256 checked before unzip; zip-slip and size refusals; https only; min_native vs OTA_NATIVE_CONTRACT; deterministic zip.
assets.notes: The Java parts need an APK reinstall; the web parts ship OTA.

assets.title: MicPermissionFastPath and pre-Bridge web-root selection
assets.what: Grants an already-held mic permission inline (skips a Handler hop) and stamps request/grant times.

assets.title: PipedRecognizer beep-free on-device STT and CallMicPlugin
assets.what: Owns one AudioRecord piped into the on-device SpeechRecognizer (API 33+): no earcons, no restart gaps.
assets.notes: en-IN hardcoded and unmeasured.

assets.title: Capacitor config, manifest permissions, APK CI
assets.what: Splash, status-bar icon mask, OTA origin compiled in, FGS permissions; CI runs gates, cap sync and gradle.

assets.title: Camera via <input capture>, no native plugin
assets.what: The WebView already fires ACTION_IMAGE_CAPTURE; a plugin would bump the native contract.
assets.notes: Good for a homework photo upload.

assets.title: Surface adapter contract with a single fail-closed gatedReply
assets.what: Exactly verify/parse/send/render; InboundEvent[] and OutboundMessage; all replies go through parse+dash+honesty gates; fails closed; surfaceDeviceId uuid-v5; memory never keyed by surface.
assets.evidence: 113 contract checks; send() never called live
assets.notes: Parent channel.

assets.title: WhatsApp Cloud API adapter (HMAC raw body, 24 h window in send)
assets.what: hub.challenge handshake; X-Hub-Signature-256 over the raw body; outside the window send returns requiresTemplate rather than substituting.
assets.notes: Parent lesson summaries via approved templates.

assets.title: Telegram/Discord adapters and multiparty design
assets.what: Admin bit as room consent, room commands, Ed25519 with deferred ACK, disclosure predicate as WHERE clauses.
assets.notes: Not for minors directly; possibly a group-study idea.

assets.title: ActivityState generic seam and activityOf single derivation
assets.what: {kind, startedAt, telegraphic facts, nameable allow-list, durable record}; T15 slot never dropped, 420 B; facts dropped whole from the end.
assets.notes: Becomes LessonModuleState.

assets.title: Move is code, talk is model (SPEC-GAMES section 0)
assets.what: Deterministic engine owns ground truth; LLM narrates semantic facts; no FEN or numbers in the prompt; per-move notes through direct(); note names every move she may say.
assets.notes: The curriculum/assessment engine decides correctness.

assets.title: Think-time table, noteVerdict send/stale/hold, settledClause
assets.what: Pure seeded think time [300 ms, 7 s] by position band; stale notes dropped; held notes re-drafted; the closed-choice clause counters the frozen prompt.

assets.title: Chess/ttt/wyr engines and activity UI (ActivityShell, GamesHub)
assets.what: Engines with measured imperfection; the shell is not a mode; her face stays in the header; chat stays mounted.

assets.title: State-transition reconciler for close/tally
assets.what: Close and tally are written by an always-mounted reconciler with a tallied flag, not by the component.

assets.title: LIFECYCLE_MATRIX (10 events x 5 contexts, carrier + reason)
assets.what: Each cell is assembly/direct/state/silent/na with a reason of at least 40 chars; every direct cell needs a live sender in the source.
assets.notes: Lesson x module x call-drop matrix.

assets.title: Gamify-without-the-lever policy and milestones engine
assets.what: Fixed-size celebration of real moments only; no streaks or variable reward; cards only in game mode; fire once, largest tier.
assets.notes: Child-ethics aligned.

assets.title: Telemetry contract and batched sink
assets.what: 4 rules; 4 s / 60-record batches; sendBeacon text/plain; IndexedDB offline queue; monotonic t_ms; seq gaps; always 200; session rollup.
assets.notes: Remove draft and keystroke capture for minors.

assets.title: Turn trace (7 legs, references not copies, retention at write)
assets.what: Spine + legs; server legs ride the response; single writer off the reply path; sanitise() forbidden keys with a 64-char cap; CTE prune (30/90 d); POST only.
assets.notes: DPDP-friendly.

assets.title: Content-free diag sink and call event taxonomy
assets.what: live_connect, live_goaway, live_rotated, live_close, floor_interrupted/yield/watchdog, ack_clips.

assets.title: Session reconstruction and RCA scripts
assets.what: Timeline joined to the log by id; findings for seq gaps, lane changes, comments with no fresh frame, over-budget replies.

assets.title: Classified upstream failure ladder and labeled key pool
assets.what: quota/deterministic/transient/empty classes; one retry on the same key with 350-700 ms jitter; 4 s deadline; family cooling; lane order for text vs attachments.
assets.notes: Azure DeploymentNotFound 7.5% means a fallback is needed.

assets.title: Per-IP rate limiter with trusted headers
assets.what: Sliding minute per bucket; x-real-ip or last hop; stale-only prune.
assets.notes: In-memory per lambda; use a shared store at scale.

assets.title: write-config (never prints values, --stub) and workflow lint
assets.what: Secrets into a gitignored config at deploy time; keyless stub for CI; rejects illegal contexts in a job-level if.

assets.title: verify-deploy (live bundle must equal built bundle) and pinned Vercel IDs
assets.what: Fails on a stale or wrong project; deploy runs only after gates.

assets.title: Vercel build: landing/app split, OTA emission, cron
assets.what: / landing, /chat app, /privacy; OTA zip before rename; hourly consolidate cron.
assets.notes: The origin/main build pulls source from a hardcoded branch tarball; avoid this.

assets.title: verify-release single gate runner
assets.what: Runs 13 gates and reports every failure together; exit code is the verdict; skipped db gates are printed; --live probes; --mp opt-in.

assets.title: check-prompt-budget through the real compiler with the worst date pinned
assets.what: Byte-identity battery, manifest arithmetic, guard/guarded parity, fixture caps, clock pinned to the year's worst date.
assets.notes: Truncation once deleted the crisis helplines.

assets.title: echosim audio-floor simulator
assets.what: Virtual-clock browser with AudioParam ramps, FakeWS, room impulse response and a speech-like signal; transpiles the real liveCall.ts; TUNE constant overrides; arbiter probe.
assets.notes: Port the FakeWS to the Azure realtime protocol; add a child-voice signal.

assets.title: Voice-path behavioural evals (spoken, device door census, mustSay)
assets.what: Assertions on the strings engines are actually handed; door census fails on any undeclared TTS door; content preservation.

assets.title: Motion, contrast and copy lints
assets.what: No transition:all or scale(0); <=300 ms; reduced-motion required; real-pixel contrast including silhouettes and veil ceilings; em-dash ban in product copy.
assets.notes: Kid readability needs stricter floors.

assets.title: Eval suite runner and persona safety-floor invariants
assets.what: Re-bundles from source every run; helplines, never-deny-AI, NEVER MANIPULATE and spoken register asserted for every registered agent.

assets.title: DESIGN-STANDARDS (mechanised vs judgment)
assets.what: Apple interruptibility rules, impeccable anti-patterns, animate frequency gate, duration table.

assets.title: World layer: sky is the clock
assets.what: 5 sky states from the real clock, per-state scrim tokens, accent solved per sky, procedural first.
assets.notes: A learning-world metaphor for kids.

assets.title: Closed sound vocabulary, REFUSED table, call gate
assets.what: 5 synthesised cues; rejections recorded with reasons; no sound during a call (echo floor); four gates.

assets.title: Three-level haptics
assets.what: tap/land/moment; a haptic is for an event, never a state.

assets.title: Module-level call status store
assets.what: Subscription store, so the call timer does not re-render the whole app.

assets.title: CallVoice presence UI and reason-contingent IncomingCall
assets.what: Presence field from real amplitude; no captions; she calls only after a dropped call; decline has equal weight.
assets.notes: Captions may be wanted for literacy; decide deliberately.

assets.title: Reason-contingent notifications and push token as reachability
assets.what: Only reply/missed call/story; permission at the first felt moment; data-only FCM; agent-scoped token; revoke deletes; inert until configured.
assets.notes: Parent notifications.

assets.title: Landing and privacy pages
assets.what: Honest-claims landing page; plain-language privacy page with a crisis-protocol section; og tags.

Sound layer: 0 contexts before a gesture; 2 cues for a 3-bubble reply (naive 4); 0 after toggling off
Resilience: fast 502 retry lands at 778 ms; production 6.7 s 502 shape lands on Azure at 6957 ms; all-slow walk bounded at 4203 ms

rejections.tried: Backchannel (hmm/haan) while the user is still speaking
rejections.what_broke: Protecting it needs a mic hold, which puts silence on the uplink, which is how the server ends the turn; the sentence splits. Unprotected, her voice leaks into the user's turn and the endpoint comes later. A prompted backchannel is cancelled by server VAD.
rejections.taxila_relevance: The teacher's listening sounds must go in the gap after the child stops.

rejections.tried: Synthesised murmur (three harmonics plus envelope)
rejections.what_broke: Not her timbre; 'weird, no energy'.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Use real clips in the teacher's voice.

rejections.tried: Lexical ack clips 'Haan', 'Acha' and in-context extraction
rejections.what_broke: Isolated words come out in citation form and sound robotic; in-context tokens (n=11) were no better; acoustic hum harvest cut nasals from mid-word.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Non-lexical acks only, unless the sound is chosen after knowing what was said.

rejections.tried: Bracketed direction [laughs softly] in a TTS payload
rejections.what_broke: Performed as laughter plus the spoken word 'Softly'.
rejections.taxila_relevance: No bracketed metadata on any spoken lane.

rejections.tried: Speaker identification to separate a second person from the owner
rejections.what_broke: Same-distance speakers have no level difference; embedding latency in the barge path; a 95% gate makes the floor 95% reliable for the owner.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Siblings and parents in the room; don't gate the child's floor on speaker ID.

rejections.tried: Swapping the live model to 2.5 native-audio
rejections.what_broke: Rejects video and misses the 600 ms barge signal.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Evaluate realtime models on barge-in and video, not only latency.

rejections.tried: Shortening silenceDurationMs
rejections.what_broke: 150/300/500 are within 50 ms; only risks cutting users off.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Don't chase latency through the endpoint knob.

rejections.tried: activityHandling NO_INTERRUPTION; turnCoverage TURN_INCLUDES_ALL_INPUT; startOfSpeechSensitivity tuning; enableAffectiveDialog
rejections.what_broke: ~16 s deafness; ASR invents Hindi from noise; sensitivity a no-op; affective dialog closed the socket 1007 Unknown name.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Test every setup field on a live endpoint before shipping.

rejections.tried: Dropping languageCode hi-IN; using the -latest alias; enabling thinking
rejections.what_broke: No prosody gain and loses hi-IN phonemes; -latest is thinking-heavy at 3-5.5 s; thinking adds seconds of dead air.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Pin language and model; no reasoning on the voice lane.

rejections.tried: Reasoning on live replies, with beat-routing
rejections.what_broke: +3.3-4.6 s; helpline over-triggering at 16.7%; routing must classify before generating, so a miss puts reasoning on the crisis turn.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Keep reasoning off the realtime lane; use background lanes for heavy thinking.

rejections.tried: Minimum-based noise-floor estimator
rejections.what_broke: Tracks the interferer's dips; falls through a TV.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Use the percentile estimator.

rejections.tried: LISTEN clamp with the floor capped at 0.04 (and raising FLOOR_MAX to 0.12)
rejections.what_broke: The threshold sat 4.1 dB under ambient so the gate never closed; raising the cap made her deaf.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Keep LISTEN_RATIO_MIN and LISTEN_ABS_MAX.

rejections.tried: Echo coefficient learning upward on mic level
rejections.what_broke: Positive feedback; the bar converges on total mic level; deaf for a whole turn.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Rise only on the r2-locked fit.

rejections.tried: Gating the SOFT path with onset confirmation; a second 43 ms utterance clock; a kappa-dependent margin ramp
rejections.what_broke: Quiet talker 7/8 -> 1/8; normal talker 840 -> 1864 ms; the ramp dominated neither cell.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Quiet children depend on the soft path.

rejections.tried: Chunk-wide RMS as her level; a fixed-size envelope ring
rejections.what_broke: Crest factor put the bar under her echo, so she self-interrupted every session at -12 dB; the ring fell off the front of a downlink running ~5 s ahead.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Peak 20 ms resolution on both sides; prune by time.

rejections.tried: Buffering silence ahead of a barge candidate
rejections.what_broke: Onset late by the prefix (76 -> 600 ms).
rejections.taxila_relevance: Ring words, not waiting.

rejections.tried: Dropping speech under congestion; refusing frames at ~185 ms backlog
rejections.what_broke: Syllables eaten or 45 s of stale replay; she went blind mid-share, which reads as lag.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Delay, never deafen; video yields to audio.

rejections.tried: Rotating immediately on goAway; reading timeLeft as ms; adopting the token's new model
rejections.what_broke: Guillotine mid-word; rotation always inside her sentence; model family could change mid-call.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Long lessons rotate; wait for quiet, parse units, pin the model.

rejections.tried: Recapping the conversation after rotation
rejections.what_broke: Declined for the companion because an unprompted turn after a socket swap feels worse.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Taxila likely needs a silent recap; measure it.

rejections.tried: NON_BLOCKING tool calls and google_search grounding inside the live session
rejections.what_broke: Unsupported on 3.1-flash-live; grounding closes 1011 quota 3/3.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Run tools beside the turn and deliver results by note.

rejections.tried: gpt-realtime-2.1-mini on Azure for the call lane
rejections.what_broke: 41-53 words/turn (14 s monologues); no plausible voice (137-192 Hz); no continuous frame channel; uneven Hinglish.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Taxila's chosen stack: must close verbosity, voice and frames gaps deliberately.

rejections.tried: Hand-assembled live-lane prompt (second assembler)
rejections.what_broke: Missed AGE_TIER_SAFETY_OVERRIDE and FORGET_DECISION, so a minor's romance refusal never reached calls; recall read an empty ref.
rejections.taxila_relevance: One compiler for every lane; child safety rules must reach voice.

rejections.tried: Call directive '(you were doing something)'
rejections.what_broke: Invited fabrication about the user.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Directives must carry facts or fences, never 'improvise'.

rejections.tried: Moving the voice to Azure TTS based on measured axes
rejections.what_broke: Ear verdict 'not human, not Indian'; accent identity is a separate property from pronunciation.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Test accent authenticity as a first-class axis for the teacher voice.

rejections.tried: Using a 266 Hz pitch anchor as a voice filter
rejections.what_broke: The shipped voice itself measured 212 Hz; the filter rejected a candidate on an anchor the incumbent fails.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Don't screen voices by Hz.

rejections.tried: Transliteration front end for Hinglish TTS
rejections.what_broke: No text stage on the live lane; ~90% accuracy; silent corruption path.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Evaluate on the realtime lane before adding stages.

rejections.tried: stream:true on the OpenRouter TTS lane
rejections.what_broke: Accepted but buffers the whole clip.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Verify streaming per vendor.

rejections.tried: Clip cache keys without voice identity; voice mirrors edited by hand
rejections.what_broke: Old voice replayed after the switch; 4 of 6 lanes moved and the gate went green.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Identity in cache keys; one writer.

rejections.tried: Choosing the TTS vendor per phrase; user keys overriding the voice
rejections.what_broke: Two voices inside one reply; fallbacks made her a different woman.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Decide the engine once per utterance; identity wins.

rejections.tried: A fixed 1.4 s TTS fuse; MAX_TRIES sized for a 9-key pool; a global cooldown consulted mid-walk
rejections.what_broke: A slow night became silence; could not cross a dead key family; re-broke the fallback (calls=0).
rejections.taxila_relevance: Two-phase fuse; walk-local dead set.

rejections.tried: Folding 5xx into deterministic errors (isQuota only)
rejections.what_broke: A single 502 aborted a 9-key pool and she never picked up.
rejections.taxila_relevance: One classifier for Azure errors.

rejections.tried: Action regex \*[^*\n]{1,80}\* for *grins*
rejections.what_broke: Deleted the emphasised words between **bold** spans.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Content-preservation controls on every speech transform.

rejections.tried: phrase() splitting at every full stop; a greedy /-+/ dash rule
rejections.what_broke: '3.30' spoken as 'three. thirty'; URLs cut; helpline 1800-599-0019 deleted.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Numbers and decimals are core to maths lessons.

rejections.tried: Ranking spoken-symbol suspects by how conspicuous they look in the source
rejections.what_broke: espeak treats the em-dash as a pause but reads arrows and ** aloud.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Measure the engine with math symbols.

rejections.tried: Faster screen frame cadence; lowering HOLD_SCROLL_MIN; loosening wake-dedupe
rejections.what_broke: 0 ms gain, +21% spend; no change; the 'duplicates' are identical screens.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Pipeline cost is the hold, not the camera.

rejections.tried: 4000 ms landing hold; waking on the leading edge of change
rejections.what_broke: Slower users waited longer and stops were silenced; mid-transition frames caused guessing.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Wake on the arrest.

rejections.tried: Adaptive frame quality tiering; a link-gate uplink pre-check
rejections.what_broke: A slideshow every 2.5 s; nothing ready when a stall clears, saves battery only.
rejections.taxila_relevance: One quality; a skipped frame retries.

rejections.tried: Spending pacing budgets on hand-off before delivery (native)
rejections.what_broke: One refused frame degraded the whole share.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Budgets on delivery.

rejections.tried: Share stop handing the call to the cascade; treating consent-denied as not a stop
rejections.what_broke: A model-family voice change nothing required; a denial left the call on another model.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Every exit returns to the primary voice.

rejections.tried: luna/terra for the vision lane
rejections.what_broke: Read part of the thread, asserted the rest, named the rejected cafe.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Vision fabrication test on homework images before choosing a model.

rejections.tried: Surface adapter returning the model's raw string
rejections.what_broke: No honesty gate; protocol markers sent as text. Copying gates into adapters would repeat the second-implementation drift.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Parent channels through one gate.

rejections.tried: Substituting a WhatsApp template outside the 24 h window
rejections.what_broke: Returns 200 while saying something else.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Refuse explicitly; parent templates are a separate flow.

rejections.tried: A pre-line before the move ('hmm, ek second')
rejections.what_broke: direct() cannot guarantee order, so the line lands after the move.
rejections.taxila_relevance: The teacher must not announce a module that already appeared.

rejections.tried: Past-tense move notes alone
rejections.what_broke: The frozen prompt said 'her move', so the model deliberated about a move already made.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Notes must state what is closed.

rejections.tried: Waiting for her silence before poking a game note
rejections.what_broke: Notes landed in story pauses and fragmented stories.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Gate on salience and rate for lesson events.

rejections.tried: Six-clause move facts; slicing the activity block at 420 B
rejections.what_broke: Commentator tone, pushed the turn info out; a sliced block cut the most important fact.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Three-clause facts; drop whole facts.

rejections.tried: Lifting call status into App; writing game close from a component
rejections.what_broke: Whole-chat re-render every second; closes lost on navigation.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Module store; transitions written by reconciler.

rejections.tried: Deterministic deal seeded per person; hand-drawn chess pieces; CSS slide on a reordered list; implicit animation end
rejections.what_broke: Same cards forever; illegible at 44 px; pieces teleported; marks invisible.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Seed per session; legibility over originality; verify animation events.

rejections.tried: Typing tick, receive cue per bubble, call-connect tone; proving a sound gate by silence
rejections.what_broke: States nag; three cues read as an alarm; in-call tones corrupt echo; a silence test cannot fail.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Closed sound vocabulary with refusals.

rejections.tried: Gates in the scratchpad (frozen persona copy, echosim with a hardcoded root); evals never run in CI
rejections.what_broke: Green against months-old bytes; the safety floor gated nothing.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Gates live in the repo and run in CI.

rejections.tried: secrets context in a job-level if; Vercel project inferred from directory
rejections.what_broke: Workflow invalid, zero jobs for 9 days; deployed to the wrong project while the probe passed.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Workflow lint; pinned IDs; verify the live bundle.

rejections.tried: A guard nothing invokes; a count-reporting subset check
rejections.what_broke: False confidence; green by construction.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Break every guard on purpose.

rejections.tried: Unpinned clock and date in byte-identity and size gates
rejections.what_broke: Flakes and a hidden exceeded cap.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Pin ambient inputs to the worst date.

rejections.tried: Seven agents in one working tree
rejections.what_broke: git reset --hard wiped others' edits.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Worktrees per agent; commit per slice.

rejections.tried: Shared credentials for research and production; dry-run flag that still spends
rejections.what_broke: Production chat returned 502 after evals drained the pool; a 'dry run' called the LLM.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Separate Azure deployments and quotas for evals.

rejections.tried: Piping verify-release into tail inside an && chain
rejections.what_broke: Exit code became tail's; a red tree was pushed.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Capture exit codes explicitly.

concepts.name: Client owns the floor
concepts.description: The server VAD is a bare detector; the client decides what the server hears by holding the mic in a ring while she speaks and releasing it only on a real claim.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Core to a teacher in noisy Indian homes; re-tune for children.

concepts.name: Speed is non-negotiable in one direction
concepts.description: The reply path may never get slower; latency is hidden in idle beats (ring, chat idle), and lanes race in parallel.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Prefetch modules and tokens during idle beats.

concepts.name: Asymmetric failure costs decide tuning
concepts.description: Over-interruptible beats uninterruptible; fire the watchdog early; never end a call by mistake.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Write an explicit cost table for comprehension decisions.

concepts.name: Position is mechanism
concepts.description: A rule appended last fired 8/8 vs 0/8 mid-brief; available-only facts go mid-tail on purpose.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Prompt compiler layout for teacher safety and pedagogy rules.

concepts.name: Frozen prompt plus contradicting notes
concepts.description: The live prompt compiles once at connect; changes travel as notes that must state what is now closed.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Lesson-state notes on the realtime lane.

concepts.name: An ordering you cannot enforce is not a feature
concepts.description: Ship the sequence that is always coherent.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Module reveal vs narration timing.

concepts.name: Move is code, talk is model
concepts.description: Deterministic engines own ground truth; the LLM narrates semantic facts and an allow-list of nameable tokens.
concepts.taxila_relevance: The assessment engine owns correctness; the teacher LLM explains.

concepts.name: Same name on a different model is a different voice
concepts.description: Voice identity is (model, voice, direction); declare every model and count swap points.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Fallbacks change the teacher's voice; minimise and declare them.

concepts.name: Identity in cache keys
concepts.description: Anything persisted across a config change carries that config in its key.
concepts.taxila_relevance: TTS clips, generated assets, embeddings.

concepts.name: Mirror, then assert, with one writer
concepts.description: Constants that cannot be imported across runtimes are mirrored and checked, and moved by one command.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Java/TS, server/client sanitisers, caps.

concepts.name: Twin parity tests
concepts.description: Assert two implementations agree rather than pinning current behaviour.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Web/Android detectors.

concepts.name: Pure extraction for testability
concepts.description: Policies live in pure files with no platform imports so they run off-device (WatchPacer, SceneReader, PcmMix, OtaState, _lanes).
concepts.taxila_relevance: Comprehension estimator and pacing as pure modules.

concepts.name: Guards are tested by breaking them
concepts.description: Every gate has an in-run negative control; counts must name their coverage.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Child-safety gates.

concepts.name: Dead writers
concepts.description: Code with no caller is indistinguishable from absent code; assert rows and completed schedules.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Learner-profile writers and parent reports.

concepts.name: Text-to-speech seam with content preservation
concepts.description: One server-side place converts writing conventions to speech, with mustSay controls.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Must extend for maths and science notation.

concepts.name: Grounding by delivery
concepts.description: She may only be asked to look at a frame that entered the socket; budgets are spent on delivery.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Homework camera frames.

concepts.name: Wake on arrest, not motion
concepts.description: 'Look at this' is the stop after movement, relative to the user's own rhythm.
concepts.taxila_relevance: A child pausing on a worksheet.

concepts.name: Reason-contingent proactivity
concepts.description: Notify only because something happened; never on absence, streak or count.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Parent notifications without guilt nudges.

concepts.name: References, not copies; retention at write
concepts.description: Traces store ids, counts and hashes; pruning happens inside the write; no read path.
concepts.taxila_relevance: DPDP minimisation for minors.

concepts.name: Fail closed at surfaces
concepts.description: No secret means refuse all; no gate means send nothing, loudly.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Parent channels.

concepts.name: Prompt sets the ceiling, model decides
concepts.description: The identical prompt gave 20.5 vs 41-53 words/turn on different models.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Measure the register on gpt-realtime-2.1 specifically.

concepts.name: Ears over numbers
concepts.description: Voices are chosen blind by ear on accent identity.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Teacher voice panel with parents and children.

concepts.name: Lifecycle matrix as code
concepts.description: Every event x context names how the agent learns about it, with a written reason.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Lesson/module/call/parent matrix.

concepts.name: Usage signals inform hearing, not feeling
concepts.description: Barge frequency and turn gaps may shape how she hears, never what she feels (Meera charter).
concepts.taxila_relevance: Comprehension estimator kept separate from the persona interior, disclosed to parents.
